business_summary.text: Alivus Life Sciences delivered a strong Q2FY27 with 16% YoY revenue growth to ₹682 Cr, driven by 20.8% growth in non-GPL business. EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 41.8% (+880 bps YoY) due to operational efficiencies and favorable product mix. CDMO business showed remarkable growth of 79.9% YoY. The company maintained conservative guidance of 10-12% revenue growth for FY27 with EBITDA margin of 30-32%.

call_points.text: EBITDA margin of 41.8% in Q2FY27, well above guided range of 30-32% for FY27
Two new CDMO contracts expected to close in early H2FY27 remain on track.
Dahej and Ankleshwar expansions on track, adding 160KL and 110KL respectively.
Inventory is expected to rise over the next few quarters as the company builds stock at favourable prices.
Raw material prices rising from solvents into KSM due to the war situation; only part passed on to customers.
Management flagged no major compliance pressure; Ankleshwar received VAI and Dahej NAI from the FDA.
R&D spend to settle around 4% of sales, focused on new API and second-generation processes.
Management guided for FY27 capex of about ₹540 crores, funded entirely through internal accruals.
EBITDA margins for FY27 are expected to be sustained in the range of 30% to 32%.
